summary: Tested all NEW backend endpoints and frontend flows per review request. 13/13 backend pytest cases pass. Frontend owner-admin modal (3 tabs), 'Gratis (manuell)' plan option in owner admin, pre-populated stock-count table (3 lines) with inline inputs/delete, personer quick-loan dialog, dt-groupby dropdown, and signup page hiding 'free' plan all verified via Playwright.
critical_code_review_comments: /app/backend/server.py is 1778 lines - consider splitting into modules (auth, owner, stock_audit, loans, teams).
Session-scoped test customer accumulates in DB (soft-deleted). Consider adding a hard-delete admin endpoint for cleanup, or a background purge task for records with purge_at < now.

owner_patch_customer email change: uses old email with .lower() but customer may store mixed-case; the current update query uses 'email': cust.get('owner_email', '').lower() — OK since emails are always lowercased at insert. Still fragile if any legacy records exist.
PUT /owner/customers/{id} (UpdatePlanIn) is duplicated by PATCH; consider removing PUT to avoid confusion.
People endpoint accepts team_ids in PersonIn but no validation that team exists in tenant.
test_credentials: raymond.d.hansen@gmail.com / Snowboard1! (platform_owner). Dynamic test customer created via /api/signup per run.
seed_data_creation: Each run creates one TEST_Klubb_* customer with plan basic (upgraded to deluxe for stock-audit tests). Soft-deleted at end of session; remains in DB with purge_at=now+365d.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test uses -n 0 to run sequentially (session-scoped fixtures). Login route is /innlogging (not /kundelogin). Signup page is /registrer. Owner panel is /app/kunder. The admin's own workspace customer is 000001 (hidden from /owner/customers via is_owner_workspace filter). Multiple leftover TEST_Klubb_* soft-deleted customers may exist in DB.
